newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel June tourist traffic rises.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel June tourist traffic rises.

text.p: Anglo-French Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel said on Friday the number of vehicles using its Le Shuttle Tourist service in June rose 11 percent on May.
Le Shuttle Tourist carried 180,730 vehicles (including coaches), said Eurotunnel.

It said that Le Shuttle Freight service, which started on June 15 after the service was shut down for a fire in the tunnel last November, has since been used by 15,683 lorries, over 60 percent up on the same time last year.
Eurostar traffic rose seven percent to 524,520 passengers from May.
Rail freight trains carried 275,225 tonnes in June, up from 227,308 tonnes a year ago.
